memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: routine follow‑up of dyslipidaemia, atrial fibrillation and hypertension.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: He feels well, no chest pain, palpitations or dyspnoea.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/84 mmHg, weight 70 kg, height 1.65 m, BMI 25.7 (obese). Advised diet low in saturated fat and daily brisk walk 30 minutes.
IMPRESSION: Stable atrial fibrillation on apixaban, controlled hypertension, dyslipidaemia awaiting lipid results.
ARRANGEMENTS: Order fasting lipid profile, fasting blood sugar, LFT, CK, creatinine, TSH and serum potassium today. Continue atorvastatin 10 mg HS, apixaban 5 mg BD, bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD, amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or black stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: review of lipid results and medication tolerance.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: No new symptoms; reports mild muscle aches in thighs.
EXAMINATION: BP 142/88 mmHg, weight 71 kg, BMI 26.1 (obese). Advised reduce red meat, increase fruits, and continue walking.
IMPRESSION: LDL remains elevated; CK slightly up, consider statin change. Atrial fibrillation well controlled on apixaban.
ARRANGEMENTS: Switch atorvastatin to rosuvastatin 10 mg OD, add fenofibrate 145 mg OD, increase bisoprolol to 5 mg OD, add hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD. Repeat lipid, LFT, CK, creatinine, TSH, K in 2 weeks. Return if worsening muscle pain, dark urine, swelling, or fever >39°C.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: evaluate palpitations and medication side‑effects.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Reports occasional palpitations, no syncope.
EXAMINATION: BP 136/82 mmHg, weight 70.5 kg, BMI 25.8 (obese). Advised avoid caffeine, maintain hydration.
IMPRESSION: Palpitations likely breakthrough atrial fibrillation; consider rate control adjustment. CK elevated, suspect fenofibrate‑related myopathy.
ARRANGEMENTS: Stop fenofibrate, reduce bisoprolol to 2.5 mg OD, keep apixaban 5 mg BD. Repeat lipid, LFT, CK, creatinine, TSH, K and INR (if warfarin started) in 2 weeks. Return if palpitations worsen, chest pain, fainting, or fever >39°C.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: routine review; patient feeling well.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: No chest pain, palpitations, or dyspnoea.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/78 mmHg, weight 70 kg, BMI 25.7 (obese). Advised maintain Mediterranean diet and weekly resistance training.
IMPRESSION: Lipids at target, atrial fibrillation silent on apixaban, hypertension controlled.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue rosuvastatin 10 mg OD, bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD, apixaban 5 mg BD, amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD. No labs due until next annual review. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or sudden swelling of legs.
